name: capacities-mcp-v2
description: Agent-oriented Capacities API 2.0 MCP server built with xmcp

scripts.lint: biome check --no-errors-on-unmatched src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json xmcp.config.ts biome.json
scripts.format: biome format --write src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json xmcp.config.ts biome.json
scripts.build: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && xmcp build
